info.title: Ownkube CLI API
info.description: API for the Ownkube CLI tool. Authenticate via browser-based flow, then use x-api-key header for subsequent requests.

organizations.description: Organizations this user belongs to. Pass an `id` as the `x-ownkube-organization` header on subsequent requests when membership is plural.

quickCreateUrl.description: Open in a browser and click Create stack (handoff mode)

AwsConnectTemplate.description: Deploy this stack yourself with AWS creds already in your environment (autonomous mode). Parameter keys match the template exactly.

awsAccountId.description: 12-digit AWS account ID once the stack reports in

status.description: pending (waiting on the stack) / configuring (provisioning access) / verified / failed

code.description: Raw CloudFormation status code this maps from

kind.description: How to recover: `retry` (transient/propagation, re-verify or re-launch the same stack), `quota` (fix an AWS limit then re-verify), `conflict` (account claimed elsewhere, use a different account).

description.description: What happened and what to do next

AwsConnectionFailure.description: Structured failure + remediation when status is `failed`

cloudAccountId.description: The connected cloud account this cluster runs in.

web.description: Optional reserved boxes for web/worker deployments. Metered (no box) is the default.

database.description: Database boxes. Every database on Ownkube Compute needs one: set `billingMode: "reserved"` and `skuId` to a box id.

cache.description: Cache boxes. Every cache on Ownkube Compute needs one: set `billingMode: "reserved"` and `skuId` to a box id.

databaseStorageGbMonthUsd.description: Database storage price per GB per month, billed on top of the box.

cpuClass.description: shared: a fraction of the vCPU is reserved, bursts to the full box. performance: half the vCPU is reserved, bursts to the full box. dedicated: the full box is reserved.

available.description: Whether the Ownkube Compute deploy path is currently open.

regions.description: Regions you can deploy to on Ownkube Compute. Pass a region `id` here as the `region` field when creating a deployment with no `clusterId`.

provisions.description: What one deploy creates, e.g. `["1 web", "1 db"]`.

deployable.description: False when the app is listed but can't be deployed yet.

ref.description: The piece's id within the app, e.g. `app`.

image.description: Container image for app pieces; null for datastores.

inputs.description: Values to collect before deploy; empty when none are needed.

connections.description: Variables the app gets set for you.

key.description: Pass the value under this key in `inputs`.

source.description: `wired`: from the app's own database or cache. `input`: from your `inputs`. `generated`: a fresh secret per deploy.

errors.description: What to fix before deploying; empty when `ok`.

inputs.description: Values for the app's declared inputs (see get_marketplace_app), keyed by input `key`.

baseName.description: Name prefix for every piece (`<baseName>-<ref>`). Defaults to the app id. Lowercase letters, digits, dashes.

templateInstanceId.description: Groups every piece this deploy created. Pass it to delete_marketplace_app to remove the whole app.

region.description: Ownkube Compute region id (from list_regions). Set this or `clusterId`, not both.

clusterId.description: Your own active cluster to deploy into. Set this or `region`, not both.

projectId.description: Owning project. Defaults to the organization's Default.

environmentId.description: Environment to deploy into; must belong to `projectId`. Defaults to the project's default environment.

inputs.description: Values for the app's declared inputs (see get_marketplace_app), keyed by input `key`.

dbSkuId.description: Database box id (from list_boxes `database`). Required on Ownkube Compute when the app includes a database.

cacheSkuId.description: Cache box id (from list_boxes `cache`). Required on Ownkube Compute when the app includes a cache.

baseName.description: Name prefix for every piece (`<baseName>-<ref>`). Defaults to the app id. Lowercase letters, digits, dashes.

enabled.description: Whether Ownkube Compute (and its wallet) is available here.

loadedInByReason.description: Total credit loaded into the wallet, in USD, keyed by inflow reason (e.g. plan load, top-up, promo credit).

topUpMinUsd.description: Minimum custom wallet top-up amount, in USD.

overdraftUsd.description: How far below zero the balance may run before workloads pause; the overdrawn amount is billed on the next plan invoice. 0 when the plan carries no overage.

CreditBalance.description: Live wallet balance, or null if the org has none yet.

enabled.description: Whether Ownkube Compute is available here.

monthlyBudgetUsd.description: Optional monthly spend cap, in USD. Null means no budget cap is set.

budgetAction.description: What happens at the budget cap: `notify` only alerts; `pause` suspends compute (data retained) like wallet exhaustion.

alertThresholdsPct.description: Percent-of-budget thresholds that fire a spend alert.

SpendControls.description: The org's spend controls, or null when compute is off.

monthlyBudgetUsd.description: Monthly spend cap in USD, or null to clear it.

budgetAction.description: At the cap: 'notify' alerts only; 'pause' suspends compute.

alertThresholdsPct.description: Percent-of-budget thresholds that fire a spend alert.

enabled.description: Whether Ownkube Compute (and its wallet) is available here.

topUpMinUsd.description: Minimum custom wallet top-up amount, in USD.

topUpMaxUsd.description: Largest top-up the plan allows right now, in USD (Pay as you go caps each top-up and the rolling 30 days). Null means no cap.

ok.description: True when the credit was added. False is a refusal, not an error: see `reason` and `message`.

allOf.description: Wallet balance after the credit landed (when `ok`).

reason.description: Why the code was refused (when not `ok`).

message.description: A user-facing sentence for the refusal (when not `ok`).

code.description: The promo code, e.g. from a `/login?ref=<code>` link.

url.description: Browser checkout URL. Open it to complete payment; the account updates once the payment settles.

tier.description: The plan to subscribe to: `personal` ($5/mo) or `team` ($20/mo). Each loads that much wallet credit every cycle.

amountUsd.description: Amount to add to the wallet, in USD. Must be at least the top-up minimum (see `topUpMinUsd` on GET /v1/credit).

hourlyCostUsd.description: Current burn rate, in USD per hour, across everything.

starterClusters.description: Count of active flat-priced Starter clusters.

egressGb.description: Outbound traffic this month, in GB.

egressCostUsd.description: Outbound traffic cost this month, in USD.

egressByRegion.description: Outbound traffic per region, billed per GB from the first GB at that region's rate. Costliest region first.

costUsd.description: Gross month-to-date cost drawn from the wallet, in USD.

gb.description: Outbound traffic from this region, in GB.

usd.description: Cost of that traffic, in USD.

projectedCostUsd.description: Straight-line projected wallet draw for the month, in USD.

isCurrentMonth.description: True while the series covers the live month; false for a completed month.

slug.description: Lowercase, starts with a letter; letters, numbers, hyphens only.

projectId.description: Owning project. Omit to use the organization's default project.

slug.description: Lowercase, starts with a letter; letters, numbers, hyphens only.

secret.description: Mark as secret so the value is never returned on reads. Echo a saved secret back with an empty `value` to keep the previous value.

value.description: The variable value. For secrets: reads blank secret values, so a secret you read back arrives with an empty value. Sending that empty value here KEEPS the previously saved secret (empty is the passthrough sentinel) rather than clearing it. To genuinely clear a secret, drop the variable from the set entirely; to change it, send the new plaintext.

env.description: The full shared env-var set for the environment (replaces the existing set). Every cluster-bound app in the environment is redeployed to apply it.

templateInstanceId.description: Set when this deployment is part of a marketplace app: every piece one marketplace deploy created shares it. Pass it to delete_marketplace_app to remove the whole app.

templateSlug.description: The marketplace app this deployment came from, e.g. `n8n`.

statusMessage.description: Why the rollout failed (for example a failed apply or a crashing pod); null unless `status` is `failed`. A failed apply can be retried with resync.

fields.description: Structured fields, keyed by their published label.

code.description: The function's inline source file contents.

sourceHash.description: Content hash of the stored source, if recorded.

ticket.description: Single-use, short-lived ticket. Present it to the relay to open the tunnel; it cannot be reused.

relayUrl.description: The relay endpoint the CLI dials.

expiresAt.description: Epoch seconds after which the ticket is no longer valid.

protocol.description: Wire protocol of the target (databases only).

host.description: Host apps in the same environment use to reach it. Null until it's running.

uri.description: Connection string for apps in the same environment.

publicHostname.description: Internet hostname, when public access is on.

publicUri.description: Connection string reachable from the internet (TLS), when public access is on.

publicReady.description: Whether the public endpoint is accepting connections yet.

paused.description: Whether billing has paused the datastore (stopped, data kept). A paused datastore accepts no connections until it resumes.

datastoreId.description: The database or cache deployment id to link.

envVar.description: Environment variable to set. Defaults to DATABASE_URL for a database and REDIS_URL for a cache.

appConfig.description: New config for a web/worker deployment.

databaseConfig.description: New config for a database deployment.

cacheConfig.description: New config for a cache deployment.

jobConfig.description: New config for a job deployment.

sendSsoInvites.description: Email a sign-on invite to newly added allow-list addresses.

code.description: New inline source. Omit to change settings only.

filename.description: Source filename (defaults to the current entrypoint).

restartedAt.description: The restart timestamp stamped on the pod template.

enabled.description: Whether maintenance mode should be on.

message.description: Optional line shown on the maintenance page. Ignored when disabling.

displayName.description: Cosmetic display label. Empty/whitespace clears it (falls back to the immutable name).

projectId.description: The project the deployment now belongs to.

moved.description: How many deployment rows moved (a marketplace app + its managed database/cache move together as one group).

targetProjectId.description: The project to re-file this deployment under.

buildArgs.description: Build arguments as a key/value map.

contextPath.description: Root directory for the build, relative to the repo root. Empty string clears it.

current.description: True when the label is the one this deployment already holds.

subdomain.description: The new address label to claim.

canRollback.description: Whether this revision can still be rolled back to. Only the most recent builds are retained. Present on list results only.

note.description: Optional note recorded on the rollback.
Optional note recorded on the promotion.

uploadId.description: Opaque id echoed back to the deploy call to identify this upload.

uploadUrl.description: Pre-signed URL to PUT the gzipped source tarball to.

contentType.description: Content-Type the upload PUT must set (matches the presign).

expiresAt.description: ISO expiry of the upload URL.

maxBytes.description: Largest accepted upload, in bytes. A bigger tarball is rejected at deploy time.

created.description: True when this call created a new app; false on a redeploy.

revisionId.description: The build's revision id (use it for build logs). Null if the app was created but its build didn't start; upload and deploy again.

clusterId.description: The new app's cluster id. Null on a redeploy.

environmentId.description: The new app's environment id. Null on a redeploy.

publicHostname.description: The new app's public address, once assigned. Null on a redeploy or for a private app.

portSource.description: Where the port came from: the request, the Dockerfile's EXPOSE, the detected framework's default, or the 8080 fallback.

defaults.description: What was chosen for the new app, including resolved defaults. Null on a redeploy.

name.description: Exact deployment name. Fails if taken. Omit to derive one from nameHint.

nameHint.description: Free-form name source (e.g. the project's directory name). Slugified and suffixed (-2, -3, …) if taken. Defaults to "app".

region.description: Region slug from list_regions. Defaults to the region the organization already deploys in, else the platform default.

port.description: Port the app listens on (also passed as PORT). Defaults to the Dockerfile's EXPOSE, else the detected framework's default, else 8080.

resourceType.description: web (default, serves HTTP) or worker (background process).

public.description: Give a web app a public URL. Defaults to true for web.

note.description: Optional note recorded on the build.

deploymentId.description: Redeploy this existing app from the upload. Omit to create a new app; the create-only fields below are rejected when it's set.

endsAt.description: When the alert resolved; null while still firing.

hostname.description: The host to link — a subdomain or the apex of a parent.
